proposal.headline: Add localized axial tightening to expose the missing oldest-rock core
proposal.observation: The observed NW–SE bedrock belt contains a narrow purple and dark-blue core, whereas the prediction exposes only unit 3 along that corridor. The prediction already reproduces much of the surrounding Jurassic exposure and northeastern yellow cover.
proposal.expected_effect: Expose units 1 and 2 in a narrow axial strip while largely preserving the existing outer contacts and Quaternary footprint.
